name: Family Favourites (Norway)
summary: Everyday dinners that Norwegian families cook week after week.

recipes.name: Kjøttkaker (Norwegian meat cakes) in brown gravy
steps: Mix the mince with the salt, potato starch and spices, then work in the milk a little at a time.
Shape 12–16 meat cakes with wet hands and brown them in a frying pan.
Boil the potatoes and peas.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook until nut-brown. Whisk in the stock gradually.
Put the meat cakes into the gravy and leave to simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Serve with potatoes, peas and lingonberry jam.

recipes.name: Karbonader (beef patties) with fried onions
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrots.
Slice the onions and fry them soft and golden in half the butter. Set aside.
Shape four patties, season with salt and pepper and fry for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Return the onions to the pan, sprinkle over the flour and add the water.
Simmer the patties in the gravy for 5 minutes and serve with potatoes and carrots.

recipes.name: Taco (Norwegian Friday tacos)
steps: Brown the mince in a frying pan.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water and simmer for a few minutes.
Chop the lettuce, tomato and cucumber and put them out with the sweetcorn, cheese, soured cream and sauce.
Warm the tortillas in the oven or in a dry pan.
Let everyone fill their own tacos at the table.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot and garlic and soften them in a little oil.
Add the mince and brown it.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato purée, water, oregano and salt.
Simmer the sauce with the lid on for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Lasagne
steps: Make the meat sauce: brown the mince with chopped onion and grated carrot, add the tomatoes, purée and oregano and simmer for 15 minutes.
Make the white sauce: melt the butter, stir in the flour and whisk in the milk. Cook for 5 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Layer meat sauce, sheets and white sauce in an ovenproof dish, finishing with white sauce.
Sprinkle over the grated cheese.
Bake at 200°C for about 40 minutes and serve with salad.

recipes.name: Brun lapskaus (Norwegian beef and potato stew)
steps: Cut the meat into cubes and brown in butter in a large pot with the chopped onion.
Sprinkle over the flour and let it brown a little.
Add the water, stock cubes and bay leaves, cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Peel the carrots, swede and potatoes, cut into cubes and add to the pot.
Cook for about 30 minutes more until the potatoes start to break up.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with flatbrød.

recipes.name: Fårikål (lamb and cabbage stew)
ingredients: 1.5 kg lamb pieces for fårikål (on the bone)
steps: Cut the cabbage into wedges.
Layer the meat and cabbage in a large pot, with salt, pepper and a little flour between the layers. Start with meat, fat side down.
Pour over the water and bring to the boil.
Simmer with the lid on for 2–2½ hours until the meat is tender.
Boil the potatoes and serve with the fårikål.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne
steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the chopped onion, garlic and pepper in a little oil.
Add the mince and brown it.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato purée, spices and drained beans.
Simmer for 15 minutes and serve with rice and a dollop of soured cream.

recipes.name: Homemade burgers
steps: Bake the chips in the oven according to the packet.
Divide the mince into four and shape flat burgers. Season with salt and pepper.
Fry the burgers for 3–4 minutes on each side, adding a cheese slice towards the end.
Warm the buns and slice the tomato and onion.
Build the burgers with sauce, lettuce, tomato and onion, and serve with chips.

recipes.name: Langpannepizza (tray-bake pizza) with mince
steps: Dissolve the yeast in the water, add the oil, salt and flour, and knead to a smooth dough. Leave to rise for 30 minutes.
Brown the mince and season with oregano and a little salt.
Roll out the dough on a baking tray lined with baking paper.
Spread over the pizza sauce and top with the mince, strips of pepper and cheese.
Bake at 225°C for 15–20 minutes and serve with salad.

recipes.name: Pølsegryte (sausage stew)
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the sausage and cut the onion and pepper into pieces.
Soften the onion and pepper in a little oil and add the sausage.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato purée, cream and paprika and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Macaroni bake with sausage
steps: Cook the macaroni for slightly less than the packet time and drain.
Slice the sausage and mix with the macaroni in a greased ovenproof dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour over.
Sprinkle over the cheese and bake at 200°C for about 25 minutes.
Serve with grated carrots.

recipes.name: Brennende kjærlighet (mash with bacon and onions)
steps: Peel the potatoes and boil until tender.
Fry the bacon until crisp, add the onions in wedges and fry until soft and golden.
Mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter and salt.
Spoon the mash onto plates and top with the bacon and onions.
Serve with pickled beetroot.

recipes.name: Fleskepannekake (oven pancake with bacon)
ingredients: 200 g lightly salted pork belly or bacon
steps: Whisk the flour with half the milk to a smooth batter, then stir in the rest of the milk, the eggs and salt. Leave to rest for 15 minutes.
Cut the pork into cubes and fry until crisp in an ovenproof frying pan.
Pour the batter over the pork.
Bake in the oven at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until golden and set.
Cut into pieces and serve with lingonberry jam.

recipes.name: Ertesuppe (yellow pea soup) with ham hock
steps: Soak the peas in cold water overnight.
Boil the hock in the water with the bay leaves for about 1 hour, skimming as you go.
Drain the peas and add them to the pot. Cook for about 1 hour until tender.
Add the chopped onion, carrot and swede and cook for 20 minutes more.
Lift out the hock, cut the meat into pieces and return it to the soup.
Season with thyme, salt and pepper and serve with wholemeal bread.

recipes.name: Pork chops with surkål (Norwegian sweet-sour cabbage) and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Heat the surkål in a saucepan.
Season the chops with salt and pepper and fry them in butter for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Whisk the gravy mix into the water and bring to the boil as directed.
Serve the chops with potatoes, surkål and gravy.

recipes.name: Pasta carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water. Keep 1 dl of the cooking water.
Fry the bacon and crushed garlic until crisp in a large pan.
Whisk the eggs, parmesan and pepper in a bowl.
Add the hot pasta to the pan with the bacon and take the pan off the heat.
Stir in the egg mixture and a little cooking water until the sauce is creamy. Serve straight away.

recipes.name: Pork stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the vegetables into pieces and strips.
Fry the pork quickly in oil over a high heat and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables for a few minutes so they stay crunchy.
Return the pork, stir in the soy sauce, honey and ginger and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Meatballs in tomato sauce
steps: Mix the mince, egg, breadcrumbs and salt and roll into small balls.
Brown the meatballs in a little oil and set aside.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic, add the tomatoes and oregano and bring to the boil.
Put the meatballs into the sauce and simmer for 10–15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Medisterkaker (pork patties) with mash and peas
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender.
Shape the pork mince into 8–12 patties and fry them through over a medium heat.
Fry the bacon until crisp and cook the peas.
Make the brown gravy as directed.
Mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter and salt, and serve with the patties, peas, bacon and gravy.

recipes.name: Pytt i panne (sausage and potato hash)
steps: Cut the potatoes, sausage, onion and pepper into small cubes.
Fry the potatoes in butter until coloured.
Add the onion, pepper and sausage and fry until everything is hot and golden.
Season with salt and pepper.
Fry the eggs and serve the hash with the eggs and pickled beetroot.

recipes.name: Chicken and coconut milk curry
steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic with the curry powder and turmeric in a little oil.
Add the chicken and fry until coloured.
Add the coconut milk, water, stock cube and sliced carrots and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the sugar snap peas for the last few minutes, season with salt and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet.
Cut the chicken and vegetables into strips.
Fry the chicken in oil over a high heat until cooked through.
Add the garlic and vegetables and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.
Toss in the noodles, soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce and serve straight away.

recipes.name: Chicken Alfredo
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli florets for the last 3 minutes.
Cut the chicken into pieces, season and fry through in butter.
Add the garlic and cream and let the sauce reduce a little.
Stir in the parmesan and season with salt and pepper.
Toss the pasta and broccoli in the sauce and serve.

recipes.name: Oven-baked chicken in curry cream sauce
steps: Place the chicken breasts in an ovenproof dish and sprinkle with salt.
Scatter the onion and pepper pieces around the chicken.
Mix the cream, ketchup and curry powder and pour over.
Bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Cook the rice and serve with salad.

recipes.name: Chicken traybake with sweet potato
steps: Cut the sweet potatoes and onions into pieces and spread them on a lined baking tray.
Add the chicken, drained chickpeas, garlic cloves and lemon wedges.
Drizzle with oil and season with thyme, salt and pepper.
Roast at 200°C for 30–35 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Scatter over parsley and serve.

recipes.name: Homemade chicken nuggets
steps: Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss in a little oil and salt and roast at 220°C for about 30 minutes.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Coat the pieces in flour, then beaten egg and finally breadcrumbs mixed with the salt and paprika.
Fry the nuggets in oil until golden and cooked through.
Serve with potato wedges and cucumber and carrot sticks.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the chicken into pieces and fry in butter until coloured.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, ginger and spices and fry for a couple of minutes.
Add the tomatoes, cream and honey and simmer for 10–15 minutes.
Season with salt and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken soup with pasta and broccoli
steps: Bring the water and stock cubes to the boil.
Add the sliced carrots and leek rings and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the macaroni and the chicken in small pieces and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets and cook for 3 minutes more.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with wholemeal bread.

recipes.name: Chicken pitta
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and toss with the spice mix and oil.
Fry the chicken through in a hot pan.
Slice the peppers and spring onions and tear the lettuce.
Warm the pittas in the toaster or oven.
Fill the pittas with lettuce, vegetables, chicken and a dollop of yoghurt.

recipes.name: Baked chicken legs with mushroom sauce
steps: Place the chicken in an ovenproof dish, season with salt and pepper and roast at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in a little butter.
Whisk the sauce mix into the water, bring to the boil and stir in the crème fraîche.
Spread the mushrooms and sauce over the chicken and bake for another 15–20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and serve with chopped chives on top.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable stew
steps: Cut the chicken, potatoes and vegetables into cubes.
Brown the chicken in a little oil in a pot.
Add the onion and celery and fry for a couple of minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrots, tomatoes, tomato purée, water and stock cube and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with wholemeal bread.

recipes.name: Fiskekaker (fish cakes) with chive sauce
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Blitz the fish, salt and potato starch in a food processor, then add the egg, milk and grated onion a little at a time until the mixture is smooth.
Shape cakes with a wet spoon and fry them golden in butter, about 3 minutes on each side.
Mix the soured cream with finely snipped chives and a little salt.
Serve the fish cakes with potatoes, chive sauce and grated carrots.

recipes.name: Fish fingers with mash and carrot slaw
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash them with warm milk, a knob of butter and salt.
Cut the fish into finger-thick strips and sprinkle with salt.
Coat the strips in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry the fish fingers golden in butter, about 2 minutes on each side.
Grate the carrots and apple into a slaw and serve with the fish fingers, mash and remoulade.

recipes.name: Oven-baked salmon with cauliflower and spinach
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Break the cauliflower into small florets, toss in oil and salt and roast at 200°C for 10 minutes.
Add the salmon to the tray, season with salt and pepper and roast for another 12–15 minutes.
Fold the spinach into the hot cauliflower.
Serve the salmon with the vegetables, potatoes, lemon wedges and soured cream.

recipes.name: Fiskegrateng (Norwegian fish and macaroni bake)
steps: Cook the macaroni and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and whisk in the milk. Cook the sauce for 5 minutes and let it cool slightly.
Stir in the egg yolks, salt and nutmeg, then fold in the stiffly whisked egg whites.
Put the fish pieces and macaroni in a greased dish and pour over the sauce. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Bake at 180°C for about 40 minutes and serve with grated carrots.

recipes.name: Plukkfisk (flaked salt cod in white sauce)
steps: Boil the potatoes and cut them into cubes.
Poach the fish in lightly salted water for about 8 minutes, then flake it, removing skin and bones.
Make a white sauce with the butter, flour and milk and season with nutmeg and pepper.
Gently fold the fish and potatoes into the sauce and heat through.
Serve topped with crisp bacon and chopped chives.

recipes.name: Poached cod with butter sauce and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Make cucumber salad: slice the cucumber thinly and toss with the vinegar, sugar and a little water.
Bring the water and salt to the boil, add the fish in pieces and poach gently for 6–8 minutes.
Bring the cream to the boil, take the pan off the heat and whisk in the butter in pieces. Season with lemon and parsley.
Serve the cod with potatoes, butter sauce and cucumber salad.

recipes.name: Creamy fish soup
steps: Cut the onion, carrots and leek into small pieces and soften them in butter.
Sprinkle over the flour and gradually stir in the fish stock.
Add the cream and simmer the soup for 10 minutes.
Add the fish in cubes and let it poach for 4–5 minutes without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with chives and serve with wholemeal bread.

recipes.name: Fish tacos
steps: Cut the fish into pieces and toss with the taco seasoning and oil.
Fry the fish in a hot pan for 2–3 minutes on each side.
Shred the cabbage and mix with a little lime juice and salt. Dice the tomatoes and avocado.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill the tortillas with cabbage, fish, tomato, avocado and soured cream.

recipes.name: Seibiff (pan-fried coley) with onions
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrots.
Slice the onions and fry them soft and golden in half the butter. Set aside.
Cut the fish into portions and coat in flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
Fry the fish in the rest of the butter for 2–3 minutes on each side.
Spread the onions over the fish, add the water and leave to simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with potatoes and carrots.

recipes.name: Pasta with hot-smoked salmon
steps: Cook the pasta.
Soften the chopped spring onions and garlic in a little oil.
Add the cream and peas and simmer for a couple of minutes.
Fold in the spinach and flaked salmon and heat gently.
Toss with the pasta, season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.name: Lightly salted cod with bacon
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrots.
Put the cod into boiling water, take the pan off the heat and leave the fish to poach for 8–10 minutes.
Fry the bacon until crisp and melt the butter.
Place the fish on a dish and scatter over the bacon, parsley and pepper.
Serve with potatoes, carrots and melted butter.

recipes.name: Pannekaker (Norwegian pancakes) with blueberry jam
steps: Whisk the flour with half the milk to a smooth batter.
Stir in the rest of the milk, the eggs, salt and sugar and leave the batter to rest for 15 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan and pour in a thin layer of batter.
Fry the pancakes golden on both sides.
Serve with blueberry jam and sugar.

recipes.name: Creamy mushroom pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Slice the mushrooms and fry them in butter until coloured.
Add the chopped onion and garlic and fry for a couple of minutes more.
Add the cream and soy sauce and let the sauce reduce a little. Fold in the spinach.
Toss with the pasta, season and serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Mac 'n' cheese with cauliflower
steps: Boil the macaroni and small cauliflower florets together for 6–7 minutes, adding the peas for the last minute, then drain.
Melt the butter with the crushed garlic, stir in the flour and whisk in the milk.
Stir in most of the cheese and season with salt and pepper.
Fold the macaroni and vegetables into the cheese sauce and tip into an ovenproof dish.
Sprinkle over the rest of the cheese and the breadcrumbs and bake at 200°C for about 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Tomato soup with egg and macaroni
steps: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in a little oil.
Add the tomatoes, tomato purée and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend the soup smooth with a stick blender and stir in the cream and sugar. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the macaroni in the soup until tender, and boil the eggs for 8–9 minutes.
Serve the soup with the eggs cut into wedges.

recipes.name: Cheese omelette
steps: Lightly whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a large frying pan and add the diced pepper.
Pour in the egg mixture and let it set over a medium heat, gently drawing it in towards the middle.
Sprinkle over the cheese, cover and let the omelette finish on a low heat.
Cut into four and serve with wholemeal bread and salad.

recipes.name: Vegetarian bean tacos
steps: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in a little oil.
Add the drained beans, cumin, honey and stock and simmer for 10 minutes. Mash some of the beans.
Shred the red cabbage and lettuce and crumble the feta.
Warm the tortillas.
Put everything on the table and let everyone fill their own tacos.

recipes.name: Potato and leek soup
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut into cubes, and slice the leeks into rings.
Soften the leeks and garlic in oil in a pot.
Add the potatoes and stock and cook for about 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the cream and milk and blend the soup smooth with a stick blender.
Season with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with baguette.
